name: San Fernando 818
detail: Hometown design on poured pink & gold marble, in custom black frame
description: A love letter to the San Fernando Valley. Hand-painted "818" on a base of poured pink, lavender and gold acrylic, sealed and mounted inside a matte black 5×7 frame. Ready to hang or sit on a shelf — built for both.

name: Silver & Black
detail: Raiders crest on silver fluid pour, sealed and framed in silver
description: For the Raider Nation. The official Raiders shield set against a swirling silver and black acrylic pour, sealed in resin and finished in a brushed silver frame. A statement piece for the wall, the bar, or the man-cave.

name: Heart Drips
detail: Four hearts, drips & splash. Acrylic, spray paint & markers on canvas.
description: A big love piece. Four hand-painted hearts — two purple, one pink, one red — on a chaos of color-splash and paint drips. Built with acrylic paint, spray paint, acrylic markers and acrylic mops. Ready to hang.

name: Heart in a Cloud
detail: Hand-painted black heart inside a graffiti cloud, spray & acrylic on canvas
description: Pure street-art energy. A bold black heart floating inside a hand-painted cloud, against a hot pink background. Spray paint, acrylic and acrylic markers on canvas. Ships ready to hang.

name: Love, Love, Love
detail: Hand-lettered "love" repeated in every color. Spray & acrylic markers on canvas.
description: A canvas full of love. The word repeated freehand in twelve different colors and angles, with two tiny black hearts in the corners, over a red watercolor wash. Hand-lettered with acrylic markers and spray paint.

name: Solar Cells
detail: Acrylic pour in yellow, ochre & deep brown. Honeycomb cell pattern.
description: A sun-warmed pour. Yellow, ochre and burnt-orange acrylic meet across an 8×8 canvas, breaking into hundreds of organic cells. Each cell formed naturally during the pour — no two are alike. Ready to hang.

name: Think Blue
detail: LA Dodgers logo on poured indigo & silver swirl, sealed in resin
description: Dodger Blue, made the NVee way. The interlocking LA on a base of poured indigo, royal and ice-blue acrylic with silver streaks, sealed under a glass-smooth layer of resin. 5×5" panel.

name: Blue Tide
detail: Cobalt, ice & silver pour. Stretched mini canvas, signature NVee blues.
description: NVee blue in its purest form. Cobalt, ice and a touch of silver poured across a stretched mini canvas — the same palette as the logo, frozen mid-flow. Sits in a frame, on a desk, or grouped with the other Fluid Minis.

name: Pansy, Violet
detail: Hand-pressed viola on jet-black acrylic, sealed in glossy resin
description: A real pansy, preserved forever. A single hand-pressed viola flower set against jet-black acrylic and sealed under a glass-smooth layer of resin. A piece of garden, kept exactly as it was on the day Veronica found it.

name: Pansy, Honey
detail: Yellow viola petals preserved in epoxy on black canvas
description: Soft honey-yellow viola petals with their signature purple "tiger" markings, pressed onto a 4×4 black acrylic mini canvas and locked in clear epoxy. Sweet, small, and surprisingly affecting.

name: Single Rose
detail: Single red rose preserved in resin on a black ceramic tile
description: The smallest piece in the studio, and one of the most popular. A single red rose, hand-placed at the center of a black tile and sealed under high-gloss resin. Perfect for a desk, a nightstand, or as a gift.
